props.name: titleAddon
props.description: Sits right after the title, e.g. a help icon. Not part of its accessible name.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Pass `null` for a controlled dialog opened from elsewhere.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the card. `full` fills the viewport less a margin.

props.name: modal
props.description: `false` leaves the page behind interactive: no overlay, no focus trap, and clicking outside keeps the dialog open.

examples.title: Dialog · gutter controls
examples.code:
<Dialog
  title="Share this piece"
  description="Controls sit in the corner gutter, clear of the title."
  trigger="Open dialog"
  controls={["minimize", "maximize", "close"]}
  controlsPlacement="gutter"
/>

examples.title: size sm
examples.code:
<Dialog
  size="sm"
  title="Small dialog"
  description="20rem wide."
  trigger="Open sm"
/>

examples.title: modal={false}
examples.code:
<Dialog
  modal={false}
  title="Non-modal dialog"
  description="No overlay. The page behind stays scrollable and clickable."
  trigger="Open non-modal"
  controls={["minimize", "maximize", "close"]}
/>

examples.title: size xl
examples.code:
<Dialog
  size="xl"
